resolved.SceneRuntime.release: Exact-instance teardown: synchronously revokes holder/generation, then awaits only that instance release and removes its own identity/context in finally. Independent frame-drain completions are consumed and inventoried in v1-scene-adapter.js.
resolved.SceneRuntime.releaseAll: Final synchronous closed/generation fence, followed only by joining captured pending and release promises. Their inputs are inventoried at scene-runtime load and adapter release; nothing is admitted after closed.
